research_caveats: Pass 1 + pass 2. WebFetch could not reach lender domains (network policy), so all facts come from WebSearch summaries of lender pages and trade press. Phone numbers, emails and licence numbers appear only where a search extract showed them verbatim; spot-check before use. The shared 200-call WebSearch budget ran out in pass 2 after 53 of 75 planned searches, so the arbor/stormfield/ACRES/Fairbridge California checks were not run. A first-pass error was corrected: Sabal Capital is Irvine-HQ and Regions-owned (not Long Beach). Silver Hill Funding was moved to excluded (no activity found after 2018).
